name: TradeXpert
summary: TradeXpert is a trading utility panel (TradePane) with an information display (InfoPane) and comment/logging system (Commenter) for MetaTrader 5. It provides a GUI-based interface for manual trade management rather than automated strategy-based trading. The included indicator (TradeXpertLogs) serves as a separate-window trigger for the logging display feature.
summary_zh: TradeXpert是一个交易工具面板，包含交易操作面板（TradePane）、信息显示面板（InfoPane）和日志评论系统（Commenter），用于MetaTrader 5平台的手动交易管理。它提供基于GUI的交互界面而非自动化策略交易。附带的指标（TradeXpertLogs）作为日志显示功能的独立窗口触发器。
strategy_analysis: TradeXpert并非自动交易EA，而是一个交易辅助工具套件。它通过TradePane提供可视化的交易操作面板，允许用户手动下单和管理仓位。InfoPane负责在图表上显示账户和交易相关信息，如余额、净值、持仓详情等。Commenter组件提供日志和评论功能，可通过TradeXpertLogs指标在独立窗口中触发显示。整体架构采用事件驱动模式，通过OnChartEvent处理用户界面交互，OnTimer和OnTick分别处理定时更新和实时行情刷新。该工具不包含任何自动入场或出场策略逻辑，所有交易决策由用户手动完成。
strategy_analysis_en: TradeXpert is not an automated trading EA but rather a trading utility suite. It provides a visual trading operation panel through TradePane, allowing users to manually place and manage orders. InfoPane displays account and trading information on the chart, such as balance, equity, and position details. The Commenter component offers logging and commentary functionality, which can be triggered for display in a separate window via the TradeXpertLogs indicator. The overall architecture follows an event-driven pattern, handling user interface interactions through OnChartEvent, while OnTimer and OnTick handle periodic updates and real-time quote refreshes respectively. This tool contains no automated entry or exit strategy logic; all trading decisions are made manually by the user.

pros: 提供可视化交易面板，方便手动快速下单和管理仓位
模块化架构设计，TradePane、InfoPane、Commenter各司其职，便于维护和扩展
集成日志评论系统，有助于交易记录和复盘分析
pros_en: Provides a visual trading panel for quick manual order placement and position management
Modular architecture with TradePane, InfoPane, and Commenter separated by responsibility, easing maintenance and extension
Integrated logging and commentary system aids in trade recording and post-analysis review
cons: 不具备自动化交易策略功能，仅依赖手动操作，无法实现无人值守交易
源代码中未见明确的错误处理机制，如面板初始化失败的检测和处理
缺少可配置参数（如面板位置、颜色、显示项等），用户自定义能力有限
cons_en: Lacks automated trading strategy functionality, relying entirely on manual operation with no unattended trading capability
No explicit error handling visible in the source code, such as detection and handling of panel initialization failures
Lacks configurable parameters (e.g., panel position, colors, display items), limiting user customization
improvements: 增加面板初始化返回值检查和错误处理逻辑，提高程序健壮性
添加可配置的输入参数（如面板位置、主题颜色、信息显示选项），增强用户自定义体验
improvements_en: Add return value checks and error handling logic for panel initialization to improve robustness
Add configurable input parameters (e.g., panel position, theme colors, info display options) to enhance user customization

risk_points: 作为工具类程序，不自动开仓，本身无交易风险
用户通过面板手动操作仍需注意滑点和手续费成本
risk_points_en: As a utility tool that does not open positions automatically, there is no inherent trading risk
Users operating manually through the panel should still be mindful of slippage and commission costs
